item.title: Man charged in multiple robberies in Montgomery
item.description: The incidents took place between January 26 and February 10.

item.title: Showers Wednesday; Sunshine but slightly cooler Thursday, Friday
item.description: A cold front was located in central Alabama during the early afternoon, and continues south through the rest of the day. Along the front, isolated to widely scattered showers bring brief downpours to some of our area.

item.title: “Dawson’s Creek” star James Van Der Beek dies at 48 after cancer battle
item.description: James Van Der Beek revealed in 2024 that he was being treated for colorectal cancer.

item.title: Montgomery man arrested on domestic violence charges
item.description: CrimeStoppers says a tip has led to the arrest of a Montgomery man wanted on domestic violence charges.

item.title: Wetumpka’s Mardi Gras Festival Promises Fun for the Whole Family
item.description: The Mardi Gras Festival is taking over downtown Wetumpka this Saturday, February 14.

item.title: Tyler Tanner scores 25 points to help No. 19 Vanderbilt outlast Auburn 84-76
item.description: The Tigers suffer their second consecutive loss as they fell to Vanderbilt 84-76.

item.title: Alabama sets a date for annual A-Day Game
item.description: The University of Alabama has set a date for its annual A-Day Football Game. The Tide will play its team scrimmage on Saturday, April 11th.

item.title: Trending Slightly Cooler Late Week
item.description: Northerly winds will usher in cooler air that will help drop temps into the upper 30s to lower 40s for overnight lows.

item.title: Soloman Marlow signs with Miles
item.description: Trinity's Soloman Marlow signs to continue his football career at Miles College.

item.title: ALEA special agent shot in Montgomery
item.description: Action 8 News was on the scene in west Montgomery where an ALEA special agent was shot Wednesday evening.
